title: Complaints and human support - explained
content: A complaint records an unresolved service issue for review. A support agent can help distinguish a transaction dispute from a general service complaint and explain the institution's tracking process. Keep the issue timeline and any earlier support references so the reviewer can avoid repeating completed checks.
